rationale: A wins because it knows where the bodies are buried: the strongest story is not the mattress, it is the boundary around it. "A sleep clinic is studying a consumer mattress — and the results aren't in yet" is the kind of honest, usable discomfort a founder needs before walking into health press. B has two strong angles, but "Why athletes and biohackers are the test market for blood-oxygen sleep tracking" turns a marketing audience into a story before it has a named human, usage pattern, or data. That is exactly how a decent pitch becomes a reporter's delete-with-eyeroll.
gaps_in_A: "Snoring detection lands in the biohacker bed before it lands in the sleep clinic" overreaches rhetorically; snoring and oxygen signals are already sleep-medicine territory, so the headline muddies an otherwise sharp category-adjacency angle.

The study angle says "a privately held company funding or partnering on research"; funding is not in the supplied facts, even though it hedges with "or partnering." Better to keep it to partnership/control/publication questions unless funding is confirmed.
A gives four defensible angles, but the fourth needs incumbent response or clinician color so badly that it should be marked softer than the first three.
gaps_in_B: "Why athletes and biohackers are the test market for blood-oxygen sleep tracking" is too eager. The update says Eight Sleep markets to them; it does not say they are the test market or that any of them use the new metrics.

"A consumer-tech reporter at a gadget/reviews outlet" weakens the paywall angle. Reviews desks can mention the tier, but the real story belongs to subscription-economy, consumer-affairs, or product-accountability reporters.

"A mattress that watches your breathing and changes its own temperature while you sleep" is one proof question away from a product blurb; without competitor or prior-version contrast, it is padded trend packaging.

B largely throws away the clinic-study material as only "a logo," missing A's better frame: the study process itself can be the story if the protocol, publication control, and investigator are available.
